Enlisted is the War Mode buff when enlisted for open world PvP. The buff provides additional experience for those who enter War Mode. At level 110 and above, the world quests in the Broken Isles and Argus provide increase rewards for gold and currency while at level 111 and above, the buff provides increased rewards from world quests on Kul Tiras and Zandalar. Since patch 8.1.0, if a faction is lacking the amount of War Mode users compared to the other faction, a Call to Arms is applied to the faction which increases the percentage by 5-10% more, bringing the total possible percentage up to 20%.
